Area of a Sector, Class 10 board exam: sector ka area dekh ke dar lagta hai? Find the area of a sector of radius 6 cm and angle 60°, step by step with one formula.

• Formula: area of a sector = (θ/360°) × πr²
• Put θ = 60°, r = 6 cm, π = 22/7: A = (60/360) × (22/7) × 6²
• 60/360 = 1/6 and 6² = 36, so A = (22/7) × (36/6) = (22 × 6)/7
• A = 132/7 cm², about 18.86 cm²
